gloss: bravado; bluff; putting on a brave face

definitions.explanation: Pretending to be strong or unaffected when one is actually hurt, scared, or upset.

examples.japanese: {強|つよ}がり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}わないで→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Don't pretend to be tough./Don't put on a brave face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{強|つよ}がり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}ていて→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{痛々|いたいた}しい→痛々しい：08221_itaitashii⟧。
examples.english: His bravado is painful to watch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悲|かな}しい→悲しい：00783_kanashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{強|つよ}がり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She's putting on a brave face even though she's really sad.

examples.japanese: {強|つよ}がり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やめて→やめる：00909_yameru⟧、⟦{素直|すなお}→素直：00391_sunao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{助|たす}け→助け：07777_tasuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めよう→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's stop putting on a brave face and honestly ask for help.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦あれ→あれ：00916_are⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{強|つよ}がりだった⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: He said "I'm fine," but I think that was just bravado.

notes:
FORMS:
{強|つよ}がる (to act tough) + り (noun-forming suffix) → acting tough = bravado

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {強|つよ}がり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ - to say something brave/tough (when one doesn't feel it)
- {強|つよ}がり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to put on a brave face
- {強|つよ}がり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やめる→やめる：00909_yameru⟧ - to stop pretending to be tough

RELATED VERB:
- ⟦{強|つよ}がる→強がる：15929_tsuyogaru⟧ - to act tough, to put on a brave front

USAGE:
{強|つよ}がり describes hiding one's true vulnerable feelings behind a facade of strength. It often carries a slightly sympathetic or sad connotation.

cross_references.label: to act tough, to put on a brave front
